### Review notes
I visually inspected both references and the concrete base color. The keyframe shows the faceted silver car, white/cyan jets and ground vapor, and steep right-side ramp with red edges and white center line. The rear reference visibly includes the continuous light bar, four circular rear ports, and **RDSTR** plate.

The images share a prompted design language but were generated independently—not reference-locked—and lean toward a boxier wedge silhouette. Hover height is illustrative, not metrically verified.

The concrete has fine gray grain and faint rectangular panel boundaries. **Both-axis seamless tiling was enabled**, but edge continuity and normal-map orientation have not been independently verified. These remain style/design references and a surface-map set for your procedural 404 geometry.
